concepts.gloss_en: The building/edifice of Malkhut of holiness (the two pure birds), as opposed to the Malkhut of the klipah

members.note: representative; full form with qualifier דקדושה
same single passage (lm1:3); the bare form is a truncation of 'בנין המלכות דקדושה' referring to the same pure/holy Malkhut, explicitly contrasted with Malkhut of the klipah in the very sentence

notes: Both forms occur in the identical sentence of lm1:3; the shorter is shorthand for the longer. Merged as 'likely' rather than 'obvious' because the qualifier דקדושה carries a real semantic contrast (holiness vs klipah); a reviewer may prefer to keep the unqualified head separate if it later appears in a generic sense elsewhere.
